entities.name: Ádám Miklósi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ádám Miklósi is a Hungarian ethologist, expert on dog cognition and behavior. He holds the position of professor and, between 2006 and 2024, head of the Ethology Department at the Faculty of Sciences of the Eötvös Loránd University in Budapest, Hungary. In 2016 he was elected as a corresponding member, in 2022 as a full member of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences. He is the co-founder and leader of the Family Dog Project, which aims to study human-dog interaction from an ethological perspective.
